fixed_on: 2026-09-30, before the first protocol run; decisions D9-D11 applied the same day

protocol.laplace_number_definition: La = rho*gamma*lambda/mu^2 (Popinet 2009, section 5.3); Oh = 1/sqrt(La) = 0.0183, epsilon = nu*k^2/omega0 = 0.0458
protocol.time_step: Decision D13 (2026-10-05): the lagged normal-increment capillary term is on (Surface_tension_semi_implicit = NormalIncrement) and every level uses 50 steps per inviscid period 2*pi/omega0: dt = 7.98e-3, 200 steps, one step shared by all levels (dt = 1.8/5.1/14.5 times the one-sided capillary limit at lambda/h = 16/32/64). Outputs every 2 steps (100 outputs). The check at 100 steps per period is generate_case.py --dt-divisor 2; see time_step_criterion.
protocol.time_step_before_D13: Until 2026-10-05, with the term off: One time step shared by all levels (decision D10): the largest dt within the one-sided capillary limit of the finest level, sqrt(rho*h^3/(4*pi*gamma)) with h = lambda/64 (= (1/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(rho*h^3/(2*pi*gamma))), that divides the run into 100 equal output intervals: dt = 5.50e-4, 2900 steps. The spatial study at 16/32/64 therefore carries no level-dependent time error. Reproduced by generate_case.py --dt-rule capillary-limit --surface-tension-semi-implicit None.
protocol.reference: Prosperetti initial-value solution for a free surface (Phys. Fluids 19, 195 (1976); Phys. Fluids 24, 1217 (1981), one-fluid limit), fitted with the same damped-cosine model on the same output times as the simulation
protocol.note: Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, transport, Laplace number, dt divisor) spatial study at one shared time step; the divisor-1 study needs every level, the divisor-2 study the levels in time_step_criterion.refined_step_levels. See README.md for the definitions and the cost of each level.
protocol.time_step_study: Gated since 2026-10-05 (D13, time_step_criterion): dt/2 (100 steps per period) at lambda/h = 64. Every level run at two or more divisors (1, 2, 4) is also reported.
protocol.transport: Level-set advection with the PDE velocity extension of decision D9 once it is in the solver (generate_case.py --transport pde_extension); until then wet_extension (wall_compatible_normal), the D9 comparison baseline. Criteria apply per (capillary form, transport) study.

criteria.definition: |omega_sim - omega_ref| / omega_ref. omega_sim is the angular frequency of the least-squares fit exp(-beta t)(c1 cos(omega t) + c2 sin(omega t)) to the cos(kx) mode amplitude a_h(t) over all outputs including t = 0; omega_ref is the same fit to Prosperetti's a(t) sampled at the same times.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels, on the spatial study at the shared time step (D10); pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: frequency error <= 2% at lambda/h = 32, with convergence over 16/32/64). First order is the rate expected for the force on a piecewise-planar interface (Gross and Reusken 2011, ch. 7), as for the static-drop pressure jump.

criteria.definition: |beta_sim - beta_ref| / beta_ref with beta the amplitude decay rate of the same two fits.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(lambda/h) over order_levels, on the spatial study at the shared time step (D10); pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M3: damping error <= 5% at lambda/h = 32, with convergence over 16/32/64), also applied at the finest level (lambda/h = 64) as in decision D12.

criteria.definition: max over the whole run of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0) (decision D11): over all VTU outputs and, when solver_run.log[.gz] is present, over the per-step 'Wet volume diagnostic' areas of every accepted step. A is the exact area of {phi_h < 0}; A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5: volume drift <= 1e-4, as for M1 and M2, applied to M3), gated on the maximum deviation over the run (decision D11). A(0) includes the whole liquid layer (depth ~ lambda); mean_level_drift_over_amplitude reports the same drift relative to a0.

time_step_criterion.source: Decision D13 (design note Documentation/free_surface_semi_implicit_surface_tension_design.md, section 9.9): every gate passes at both steps, and the fitted frequency and damping change by at most 0.2% and 1% when the step is halved, at the finest level. Measured in section 9.5 (Richardson time error at lambda/h = 64, 50 steps per period): -0.16% in frequency, -0.5% in damping.
time_step_criterion.definition: |q(dt) - q(dt/2)| / |q(dt/2)| for the frequency omega and the damping rate beta of the damped-cosine fit to the simulated a_h(t), between the dt divisor 1 and 2 runs of one (capillary form, transport, Laplace number) at their finest common level.
time_step_criterion.at_level: finest common level of the dt and dt/2 runs (protocol: lambda/h = 64)
time_step_criterion.gates_at_each_step: every criterion applies to the dt study (all levels) and to the dt/2 study at the levels in refined_step_levels; criteria at levels not run at dt/2 are reported as not run
time_step_criterion.when_one_divisor_only: reported as not evaluated; does not fail
